'''Cheerstella''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Cheerspring]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "With each move, Cheerstella transforms the battlefield into a starlit stage. All you need to save the world is music and a smile, after all, and as long as the dance goes on, there's nothing our fellow Tatari can't do!"

Cheerstella is a rainbow rarity Tatari with an emphasis on bolstering its allies and reinforcing the front line. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Appearance ==
A white, anthropomorphic rabbit with large, red eyes. Its body is covered in purple fur, growing darker along its ears and feet. There is a yellow medical cross emblazoned on its chest, and it holds a magic wand in one hand. The ends of its large ears are fluffy, orange, and yellow.

Cheerstella's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces everything that's orange or yellow into blue and cyan. Only the cross emblem on its chest remains yellow, but now with a blue highlight.

== Strategy ==
[[File:Cheerstella Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Cheerstella's Attack Range]]
As with all Lightning Tier 4 Tataris, Cheerstella gains an ATK Speed increasing aura that affects all allied Tatari, granting 4% ATK Speed, with the effect being reduced on non-lightning Tatari. This aura will stack up to 5 times with 5 Tier 4 Lightning Tatari, for a total of 20% bonus ATK Speed.

It's worth noting, however, that as a Support Tatari, the additional stats from evolving to Tier 4 don't affect Cheerstella's overall performance much. Thus, it may be prudent to evolve some DPS or Tank Tatari before considering evolving Cheerstella.
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Maybe it's time to quit being an idol and become a magical girl instead. Star prism power, make up!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Cheerstella's magical staff of stars can strengthen the morale of nearby Tatari and even revive allies who have fallen."
